The API SLA risk calculator implementation achieved a perfect verifier reward by passing all functional test cases in the legacy pytest suite.
The run succeeded with a verifier_reward of 1.00 and zero exceptions across all trials. The pytest tool (version 8.4.1) reported 1 passed test in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.30s. Reusable logic includes the core weighted-risk calculation, though future iterations should ensure 'botocore' is available if Bedrock or SageMaker stream decoding is required, as noted by LiteLLM warnings.
